author: sfgate.com
title: The new iPhone XR's six available colors, ranked (AAPL)
text:
Apple
Apple just unveiled three new iPhones, including a 6.1-inch iPhone called the iPhone XR.
While the other two new phones, the iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max, will be available this month starting September 21, the iPhone Xr won't be available for awhile — it starts shipping October 26, with preorders going live a week before that.
Among the many other standout features in the iPhone XR, most notable are its colors. It's reminiscent of the iPhone 5C, the ceramic candy-colored phone that was a more affordable version of the iPhone 5S when it went on sale back in 2013.
Recommended Video: Now Playing: Apple to Unveil Three New iPhone Models Multiple leaks are hinting that three new iPhone models will hit the market. Many are speculating they will be called the iPhone XC, iPhone XS and the iPhone XS Plus. The display for the upcoming models will be 5.8-inch, 6.1-inch and 6.8-inch models. Ben Geskin, an iPhone leaker, allegedly got his hands on the soon to be launched iPhones. He posted the leaked handsets on Twitter. The new smartphones are expected to be available on September 21. Apple fans will have to wait for official details on the next iPhones on September 12.
Media: Wibbitz The iPhone XR will be available in six colors when it becomes available. And since all opinions should be taken as facts, here's our definitive ranking of the six new colors, from worst to best:
